_description: Key AI integration decisions with reasoning, alternatives, and outcomes

decision: Registry-based factory pattern for AI providers
reasoning: Adding a new provider should require only one new file. No changes to existing code, no switch statements, no config files to update.
outcome: Four providers (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama) added with zero changes to other files

decision: Providers return raw text; callers own JSON parsing
reasoning: Different callers need different parsing strategies. Centralizing parsing in the provider would couple it to specific output formats.
outcome: parseAIJson.ts handles markdown-wrapped JSON and LLM quirks in one place

decision: Prompts are pure functions returning {system, user} strings
reasoning: Decouples prompt logic from provider implementation. Easy to test, iterate, and version prompts independently.
outcome: Prompts are testable in isolation; same prompt works across all providers

reasoning: Expand provider options. Gemini offers competitive performance at lower cost for some use cases.
outcome: Users can switch providers via NUXT_AI_PROVIDER env var
